(1)
Judgment

Court
of India
in

2025
::
CIRCULAR
::
No.RJ/7+
/2025
In
view
of
the
Judgment
dated 18.07.2025 passed by
the Hon'ble
Supreme
Court
of India
in
Criminal
Appeal
No.
3053
of
2025,
in
the
case
of
Kaushal Singh
vs.
The
State of Rajasthan, as
directed
by the
Hon'ble
Chief
Justice,
all
the
Learned
Advocates/Litigants/stateholder
are
hereby
informed
that while
filing
Bail
Applications,
the
following
particulars
shall
be mentioned:
“In
every
application
for
bail
presented
to
the High
Court,
the
petitioner
shall
state
whether
similar
application
has
or
has
not
been
made
to
the High Court
and
the Hon’ble
Supreme
Court,
and
if
made
shall
state
the
result thereof.
The
petitioner/applicant
shall
also
mention whether
he/she
is/was involved
in
any
ether
criminal
case
or
not.
If
yes, particulars
and
decisions
thereof.
”
The
Circular
will
come
into
force with
effect
from
11.08.2025.
By
order
of
the Hon’ble the
Chief Justice
